stories.headline: Honor's Humanoid Robot Beats Human Half-Marathon World Record at Beijing Race in 50:26

key_facts.fact: Honor's 'Lightning' robot completed the 21km Beijing E-Town Humanoid Robot Half Marathon in 50 minutes 26 seconds using autonomous navigation, beating Jacob Kiplimo's human world record of ~57 minutes set in Lisbon in March 2026
key_facts.excerpt: The winner from Honor, a Chinese smartphone maker, completed the 21-kilometer (13-mile) race in 50 minutes and 26 seconds... That was faster than the human world record holder, Uganda's Jacob Kiplimo, who finished the same distance in about 57 minutes in March at the Lisbon road race.

key_facts.fact: Over 300 robots from 100+ teams participated, a massive increase from last year's 21 robots. About 40% navigated the course autonomously while others were remotely controlled
key_facts.excerpt: More than 300 humanoid robots participating in China's second robot half-marathon... Over 70 teams, almost five times as many as last year... almost 40% of the robot participants will navigate the course autonomously

key_facts.fact: Last year's inaugural winning time was 2 hours 40 minutes 42 seconds by Tiangong Ultra — this year's winner was more than 3x faster, a dramatic year-over-year improvement
key_facts.excerpt: The performance by the robot marked a significant step forward from last year's inaugural race, during which the winning robot finished in 2 hours, 40 minutes and 42 seconds.

key_facts.fact: Honor swept the top three positions. A separate remotely-controlled Honor robot crossed first in 48:19 but the autonomous 'Lightning' won the championship under weighted scoring rules
key_facts.excerpt: It was a clean sweep for Honor's robots, who also took second and third place medals on the podium.

key_facts.fact: China dominates global humanoid robot installations at over 80% of 16,000 units installed in 2025. AGIBOT and Unitree each shipped 5,000+ units, while Tesla accounted for only 5%
key_facts.excerpt: China dominates global humanoid robot installations, accounting for more than 80% of the 16,000 units installed worldwide in 2025, according to Counterpoint Research. The top US vendor, Tesla, only accounted for 5% of global humanoid installations

key_facts.fact: Hundreds of millions of people watched livestream coverage across Chinese platforms. Beijing's 2026-2030 five-year plan includes humanoid robots as a national priority
key_facts.excerpt: Hundreds of millions of people watched livestream coverage of the race across various platforms... Beijing's latest master plan for 2026-2030 sets out a blueprint for futuristic technologies, including brain chips, quantum computing, and factories manned by robots

sources.title: A humanoid robot sprints to victory in Beijing, beating the human half-marathon world record
Humanoid robot wins half-marathon in China; beats world record

stories.headline: Tesla Launches Unsupervised Robotaxi Service in Dallas and Houston, First Expansion Beyond Austin

key_facts.fact: Tesla announced it is expanding its robotaxi service to Dallas and Houston, the first cities beyond Austin where the service launched last year
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla is expanding its robotaxi service to Dallas and Houston, according to a social media post from the company.

key_facts.fact: Tesla is launching unsupervised (no safety driver) robotaxi rides directly in Dallas and Houston, bypassing the supervised phase it used initially in Austin
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla expands its robotaxi service to Dallas and Houston after launching in Austin last year and starting to offer rides without safety drivers in January 2026

key_facts.fact: Elon Musk promoted the expansion on social media, posting 'Try Tesla Robotaxi in Dallas & Houston!'
key_facts.excerpt: Elon Musk: Try Tesla Robotaxi in Dallas & Houston!

key_facts.fact: Industry observers noted the significance of launching unsupervised from day one in new cities, rather than starting with safety monitors, as a bullish signal for the speed of Cybercab rollout
key_facts.excerpt: I think the biggest aspect of Tesla's Robotaxi expansion is how they're going directly to Unsupervised. That is huge.

sources.title: Tesla brings its robotaxi service to Dallas and Houston

stories.headline: Global DRAM Shortage to Last Through 2027 as Chipmakers Meet Only 60% of Demand

key_facts.fact: DRAM manufacturers including Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron are expected to meet only about 60% of global demand through 2027, according to a Nikkei Asia report citing industry data
key_facts.excerpt: A shortage of memory chips appears likely to continue until around 2027, with the top U.S. and South Korean suppliers raising DRAM production at a pace that will meet only about 60% of demand.

key_facts.fact: Memory is expected to reach approximately 40% of low-end smartphone manufacturing costs by mid-2026, up from 20% previously, due to the shortage
key_facts.excerpt: Memory supply constraints continue to grip the industry as the rise of Agentic AI has led to severe shortages.

key_facts.fact: DRAM manufacturers need to increase annual production by 12% between 2026 and 2027 to address demand, but Counterpoint Research says production is only growing at 7.5%
key_facts.excerpt: DRAM manufacturers will have to increase their annual production by 12% between 2026 and 2027 to address this growing demand, but Counterpoint states that at the current rate, the production is only increasing by a measly 7.5%

key_facts.fact: AI data centers are pre-booking entire years' worth of supply, causing severe shortages in smartphone and PC segments. Samsung and others have dropped legacy DDR3/DDR4 production
key_facts.excerpt: AI factories are pre-booking entire year's worth of supply, leading to severe shortages in the smartphone and PC segments. And the majority of the new production lines will be focused on AI-specific DRAM such as HBM.

key_facts.fact: Micron's HBM4 chips are sold out through end of 2026, with the company able to fulfill only 50-66% of demand from its largest customers due to insufficient cleanroom space
key_facts.excerpt: Micron Technology finds itself in an enviable yet challenging position: its next-generation HBM4 memory chips are sold out through the end of 2026... the company can currently fulfill only 50 to 66 percent of demand from its largest customers

sources.title: Memory shortage set to run until 2027 as chipmakers focus on AI
Memory Makers Will Only Meet 60% of DRAM Demand Through 2027, Locking In Years of Shortages and Price Pain

stories.headline: SK Hynix Partners With TSMC to Use 3nm Process for HBM4E Base Die, Doubling Power Efficiency

key_facts.fact: SK hynix plans to apply TSMC's 3-nanometer process to the base die of its next-generation HBM4E product, slated for mass production next year, doubling power efficiency compared to previous versions
key_facts.excerpt: SK hynix plans to enhance its partnership with TSMC... and apply the 3nm process to the base die of its next-generation HBM4E product. According to TSMC, the 3nm base die offers twice the power efficiency of previous versions

key_facts.fact: Samsung took the lead in February by becoming the first in the world to mass-produce and ship HBM4, but SK hynix has completed its HBM4 quality certification redesign and is ready to ship in H2 2026
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics took the lead in February by becoming the first in the world to mass-produce and ship HBM4, but SK hynix has reportedly completed its HBM4 qual (quality certification) redesign and is ready to ship quality products in the second half.

key_facts.fact: A key variable is the physical distance between Korea and Taiwan requiring a three-day one-way sample transfer, and potential 3nm capacity shortages that may continue into next year
key_facts.excerpt: Variables include the physical distance between Korea and Taiwan, which requires a three-day one-way sample transfer, and potential 3nm process capacity shortages that may continue into next year.

key_facts.fact: The partnership aligns with AI chip demand for lower power consumption, as HBM is critical for Nvidia's Vera Rubin and other next-generation AI accelerator architectures
key_facts.excerpt: aligning with demand for artificial intelligence (AI) chips that consume significant power

sources.title: SK hynix Teams Up with TSMC on HBM4E, Betting on 3nm Process

stories.headline: Samsung Readies Taylor, Texas Fab for Operations With Tesla AI Chip Orders Worth $16.5B+

key_facts.fact: Key equipment has started arriving at Samsung's Taylor, Texas fab, with full-scale production expected in the second half of 2026 after more than three years of construction
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung could begin full-scale production at Taylor fab in the second half of this year. A recent report suggests that key equipment has already started arriving at the site.

key_facts.fact: Samsung plans to hold a ceremony on April 24 to mark equipment delivery, with Foundry Division President Han Jin-man and global equipment suppliers attending
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung reportedly plans to hold a ceremony on April 24 to mark the delivery of major equipment at the Taylor plant. The company's key executives, including Foundry Division President Han Jin-man, will attend the event.

key_facts.fact: Samsung secured orders for Tesla's next-gen AI chips AI5 and AI6, with the AI6 deal worth approximately $16.5 billion. TSMC will also manufacture part of the AI5 chips
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung already secured an order to make Tesla's next-generation AI chips, AI5 and AI6, at the new plant. The latter is worth about $16.5 billion... industry leader TSMC will also manufacture part of the AI5 chips.

key_facts.fact: Tesla CEO Elon Musk recently confirmed the AI5 chip design is complete and thanked both TSMC and Samsung. Mass production expected sometime in 2027
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla CEO Elon Musk recently thanked both TSMC and Samsung after confirming that the AI5 chip design is complete. The chip will likely enter mass production phase sometime in 2027.

key_facts.fact: If Samsung meets Tesla's quality standards, it could attract other major clients like Meta and Microsoft, both reportedly unhappy with recent TSMC price increases
key_facts.excerpt: Industry watchers expect that if the Korean firm meets Tesla's quality standards, it could attract other major clients such as Meta and Microsoft. Both companies are reportedly unhappy with recent price increases from TSMC

sources.title: Samsung Ready to Begin Operations at Its US Taylor Fab
Samsung accelerates Taylor fab ramp-up amid Tesla AI chip deal

stories.headline: Satellite Imagery Shows ~40% of US Data Center Projects Face Delays; Maine Passes First Statewide Moratorium

key_facts.fact: Satellite imagery from SynMax and analysis by FT/IIR Energy shows nearly 40% of US data center projects may fail to complete on schedule in 2026, including major projects from Microsoft, Oracle, and OpenAI
key_facts.excerpt: satellite imagery is showing that nearly 40 percent of US data center projects may fail to be completed this year as scheduled... major projects from tech companies such as Microsoft, Oracle, and OpenAI are 'likely to miss completion dates by more than three months.'

key_facts.fact: Industry executives cite chronic shortages of labor (electricians, pipe fitters), power infrastructure, and equipment as primary delay causes. Tariffs on Chinese transformers have worsened the situation
key_facts.excerpt: Interviews with more than a dozen industry executives highlighted data center delays caused by 'chronic shortages of labor, power and equipment'... Tariffs on imported Chinese equipment such as transformers have only made the situation worse

key_facts.fact: Maine's legislature passed the nation's first statewide moratorium on data centers above 20 MW until October 2027, now awaiting Gov. Janet Mills' signature. At least 11 other states are considering similar restrictions
key_facts.excerpt: Maine could impose the nation's first statewide moratorium on energy-hungry data centers... The legislation would institute a moratorium for more than a year on data centers above a certain size... Proposals to slap a moratorium on data centers have been introduced in at least a dozen states

key_facts.fact: Tech companies are resorting to installing on-site power plants using natural gas turbines, mobile generators on semi-trucks, and turbine engines originally designed for aircraft and warships
key_facts.excerpt: Many tech companies are even installing their own on-site power plants, with a heavy reliance on natural gas turbines... data center developers using mobile gas generators on semi trucks and turbine engines originally designed for aircraft and warships.

key_facts.fact: In 2025, at least $156 billion in data center projects were blocked or delayed amid local opposition and litigation, according to Data Center Watch
key_facts.excerpt: A report from Data Center Watch found that in 2025, at least $156 billion in data center projects were blocked or delayed amid local opposition and litigation.

sources.title: Satellite and drone images reveal big delays in US data center construction
Maine eyes pause on data centers
The public sours on AI, data centers as Anthropic, OpenAI look to IPO

stories.headline: Siemens and Humanoid Validate AI-Driven Robot in Live Factory at Erlangen, Achieving 90%+ Success Rate

key_facts.fact: Siemens and Humanoid demonstrated the HMND 01 Alpha robot performing autonomous logistics tasks at Siemens' electronics factory in Erlangen, Germany, achieving 60 tote movements per hour and over 8 hours continuous operation
key_facts.excerpt: The HMND 01 Alpha robot was tested at Siemens' electronics factory in Erlangen, Germany... Throughput of 60 tote movements per hour, Continuous operation exceeding 8 hours

key_facts.fact: The robot achieved autonomous task success rates above 90%, performing picking, transporting, and placing containers within production workflows
key_facts.excerpt: the robot performed logistics tasks such as picking, transporting, and placing containers within production workflows. Operational results included... Autonomous task success rates above 90%

key_facts.fact: The HMND 01 uses NVIDIA's physical AI stack for edge computing and simulation, which reduced development time from typical 18-24 months to approximately 7 months
key_facts.excerpt: The HMND 01 platform incorporates NVIDIA's physical AI stack, including edge computing and simulation tools... This approach reduced development time from typical cycles of 18–24 months to approximately seven months.

key_facts.fact: The robot integrates with Siemens Xcelerator platform for digital twin models, PLC interfaces, fleet management, and industrial communication networks
key_facts.excerpt: A key factor in the deployment is integration with Siemens' Siemens Xcelerator portfolio. This platform provides the infrastructure required for humanoid robots to function as part of a coordinated production system.

sources.title: Humanoid Robot Demonstrates Autonomous Logistics in Factory
